claims.subject: Centralized algorithm of Theorem 4.1
claims.evidence_quote: Corollary 3.2 The centralized algorithm of Theorem 4.1 that forms a line of r rhombical meta-modules of side length l − 1 from a line of n = r · l2 /2 amoebots within 12 rounds is stable.

claims.subject: Stable reconfiguration
claims.evidence_quote: We call a reconfiguration (S0,...,S F ) stable if and only if it is locally and globally stable.

claims.subject: Globally stable reconfiguration
claims.evidence_quote: Definition 3.2 We call a reconfiguration (S0,...,S F ) globally stable if and only if min i∈{0,...,F } α(GSi ) = Ω(min {α(GS0 ),α (GSF )}).

claims.subject: Rhombical meta-module
